about.title: Better understanding starts with better language.
about.lead: Medical reports are written for clinical precision, which can make them difficult to read outside a healthcare setting. MedSimplify translates common report language into clearer everyday English.
about.doesText: It detects terms from a starter medical dictionary, rewrites report sentences with careful wording, and keeps the original report available for comparison.
about.doesNotText: It does not diagnose, predict outcomes, recommend medication, or tell you what medical action to take.
about.note: Always use the original report and a clinician's guidance as the authoritative source for your care.
